Real-Time Metric Math

Data Quality Explorer

Simulate and visualize the impact of data defects across high-velocity carrier streams. Dynamically tweak defect sliders to evaluate overall Data Quality Score (DQS) impact.

Simulation Controls

Adjust data stream volume and injected defect ratios to evaluate downstream composite Data Quality Scores (DQS).

Injected Defect Ratio (NULLs, Schema Errors): 2.5%
Daily Shipment Stream Volume: 100,000
Mathematical Metric Formula:
DQS = 0.25*Comp + 0.25*Acc + 0.15*Cons + 0.15*Time + 0.10*Uniq + 0.10*Valid
Values below 98.0% trigger automated contract penalty audits with carrier dispatchers.
